label: Shure MXP-5 (Mxp-5B And New Construction Bracket)

_avail.note: No datasheet/user guide link published on product page.

portsSource.note: MXP-5 user guide pp.4-6 and p.12; kit = MXP-5 loudspeaker + A-MXP5-NCB or A-MXP5-TB (p.5, optional accessories)

_avail.notes: Kit with mounting accessory: loudspeaker alone is 340 x 340 x 111.9 mm, 3.28 kg (MXP-5 user guide p.5); kit dimensions/weight not published.

ports.label: Speaker In
ports.notes: IN +/- of the 4-pin block 5.08 mm; 4 ohm or 70 V / 100 V transformer taps (1.875-15 W) via tap selector; 28 W max (IEC 60268-5)

ports.label: Speaker Out (Loop)
ports.notes: OUT +/- of the same 4-pin block, parallel loop-through to the next 70 V / 100 V loudspeaker
